name: Library Cross ∞ ~Toki ga Kitara, Kono Negai o~
original_name: LibraryCross∞～時が来たら、この願いを～
source:
You have all been chosen to complete this book. In order to do so, you must defeat ayakashi.
If the book is not completed, all of you will die.

You have until…1pm.

You awake in a world you’ve never seen before. When you look up, you notice a huge clock with 13 hours marked on it. Lying next to you is a ‘white book’ that is familiar to you. You find 9 young men trapped in the same library as you. Though you try to escape through a large set of doors at the back of the room, it has been firmly locked.

To escape from this world, you have no choice but to follow the orders of a mysterious book……

In addition to the game’s original characters, characters and the worlds from 5 of Otomate’s previous games will also be making an appearance. (Hakuouki, AMNESIA, NORN9, Moujuu-tsukai to Ohime-sama, Yunohana SpRING!)

[from [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/04/27/library-cross-%E2%88%9E-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
translation:
你们全都被选中来完成这本书。为了完成它，你们必须击败妖怪。
如果无法完成这本书，你们所有人都会死。

你们的期限是……下午1点。

你在一个从未见过的世界里醒来。抬头时，你注意到一座巨大时钟，上面标有13个小时。身旁躺着一本你熟悉的“白色之书”。你发现9名年轻男子和你一起被困在同一座图书馆里。你们试图从房间后方的大门逃走，却发现门被牢牢锁住。

要逃离这个世界，你别无选择，只能遵从神秘书籍的命令……

除游戏原创角色外，《薄樱鬼》《AMNESIA》《NORN9》《猛兽使与王子殿下》《百花百狼》5部Otomate前作的角色与世界也会登场。

[来源：[url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/04/27/library-cross-%E2%88%9E-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
